title: Reading Drill — Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Foxhaven began with reports of moveable toys scratching some parts of a floor. The playgroup staff had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using dated photographs and chose the area with permanent marks as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was additional mats under storage. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted seven weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded variation in toy weight as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
